name: Helm of Pressure
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 7th; Slot head; Price 5,040 gp; Weight 4 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This heavy steel helm has only tiny slits for the eyes, nose, and mouth. Once per day, at a command word, it seals all holes and heats to a high temperature, releasing scalding steam inside and a puff of vapor from the top, together with a strong whistle.

If worn when activated, the helm deals its wearer 1d4 points of heat damage per round, and the wearer can’t breathe (so most often it’s used by tricking enemies into wearing it); if used as a pot, though, it reduces the cooking time of soups, risottos, and other meals requiring steam cooking to 1/6 the normal time.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,520 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Culinary Magic; Spells heat metal
